test_cases.test_case: Successful login with valid credentials
preconditions: User has a registered account with valid credentials.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Signed in successfully.' and is redirected to the Accounts Overview page.

test_cases.test_case: Login failure with incorrect password
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Incorrect email or password. Please try again.' and password field is cleared.

test_cases.test_case: Login with maximum length username and password
preconditions: User has a registered account with maximum length credentials.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Signed in successfully.' and is redirected to the Accounts Overview page.

test_cases.test_case: Login failure with empty username
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that the Email/Username is required.

test_cases.test_case: Login failure with empty password
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that the Password is required.

test_cases.test_case: Login with email format edge case
steps: 2. Enter an email with special characters (e.g., test+123@example.com).
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Signed in successfully.' and is redirected to the Accounts Overview page.

test_cases.test_case: Successful registration with valid data
steps: 2. Fill in all required fields with valid data.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Account created successfully — please sign in.' and is redirected to the login page.

test_cases.test_case: Registration failure with invalid email format
steps: 2. Enter invalid email format in Username field.
3. Fill in other fields with valid data.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that the Username must be a valid email format.

test_cases.test_case: Registration failure with mismatched passwords
steps: 2. Fill in all fields with valid data.
3. Enter different values in Password and Confirm Password fields.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that Password and Confirm Password must match.

test_cases.test_case: Registration with maximum length fields
steps: 2. Fill in all fields with maximum length data.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Account created successfully — please sign in.' and is redirected to the login page.

test_cases.test_case: Registration failure with empty required fields
test_cases.expected_result: User sees error messages indicating that required fields must be filled.

test_cases.test_case: View accounts overview after successful login
steps: 1. Navigate to the Accounts Overview page.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees a welcome message with their name and a table of all customer accounts.

test_cases.test_case: Open new checking account with valid data
steps: 1. Navigate to the Open New Account page.
3. Enter valid Initial Deposit Amount ($25 or more).
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Account opened successfully!' and is redirected to accounts overview.

test_cases.test_case: Open new checking account with insufficient initial deposit
steps: 1. Navigate to the Open New Account page.
3. Enter Initial Deposit Amount less than $25.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that the deposit must be at least $25.

test_cases.test_case: Open new savings account with maximum initial deposit
steps: 1. Navigate to the Open New Account page.
3. Enter maximum valid Initial Deposit Amount.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Account opened successfully!' and is redirected to accounts overview.

test_cases.test_case: Open new account without selecting account type
steps: 1. Navigate to the Open New Account page.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that an account type must be selected.

test_cases.test_case: Transfer funds between accounts successfully
preconditions: User is logged in with sufficient funds in source account.
steps: 1. Navigate to the Transfer Funds page.
2. Select 'My ParaBank Account' as transfer type.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Transfer completed successfully.' with a transaction ID.

test_cases.test_case: Transfer funds with insufficient funds in source account
preconditions: User is logged in with insufficient funds in source account.
steps: 1. Navigate to the Transfer Funds page.
2. Select 'My ParaBank Account' as transfer type.
3. Enter Transfer Amount greater than available balance.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Insufficient funds' error message.

test_cases.test_case: Transfer funds with invalid external account number
steps: 1. Navigate to the Transfer Funds page.
6. Confirm external account number with a different value.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Account numbers do not match.' error message.

test_cases.test_case: Transfer funds with maximum transfer amount
preconditions: User is logged in with sufficient funds.
steps: 1. Navigate to the Transfer Funds page.
2. Select 'My ParaBank Account' as transfer type.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Transfer completed successfully.' with a transaction ID.

test_cases.test_case: Pay a bill successfully
preconditions: User is logged in with sufficient funds.
steps: 1. Navigate to the Bill Pay page.
2. Fill in all required fields with valid data.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Payment submitted successfully.' with a reference code.

test_cases.test_case: Bill payment failure with insufficient funds
preconditions: User is logged in with insufficient funds.
steps: 1. Navigate to the Bill Pay page.
2. Fill in all required fields with valid data.
3. Enter Payment Amount greater than available balance.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Insufficient funds' error message.

test_cases.test_case: Bill payment failure with mismatched account numbers
steps: 1. Navigate to the Bill Pay page.
2. Fill in all required fields with valid data.
3. Enter different values in Payee Account Number and Confirm Account Number fields.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Account numbers do not match.' error message.

test_cases.test_case: Pay a bill with maximum payment amount
preconditions: User is logged in with sufficient funds.
steps: 1. Navigate to the Bill Pay page.
2. Fill in all required fields with maximum valid Payment Amount.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Payment submitted successfully.' with a reference code.

test_cases.test_case: Request a loan successfully
steps: 1. Navigate to the Request Loan page.
3. Enter valid Loan Amount within range.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Loan approved and created successfully!' with account details.

test_cases.test_case: Loan request failure with insufficient down payment
steps: 1. Navigate to the Request Loan page.
4. Enter Down Payment Amount less than 10%.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Minimum down payment requirement not met.' error message.

test_cases.test_case: Loan request failure with inadequate collateral value
steps: 1. Navigate to the Request Loan page.
5. Select Collateral Account with insufficient value.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Inadequate collateral value.' error message.

test_cases.test_case: Request a loan with maximum loan amount
steps: 1. Navigate to the Request Loan page.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Loan approved and created successfully!' with account details.

test_cases.test_case: Update contact info with invalid phone number format
steps: 1. Navigate to the Update Contact Info page.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that the Phone Number must follow the format (123) 456-7890.

test_cases.test_case: Update contact info successfully
steps: 1. Navigate to the Update Contact Info page.
2. Fill in all fields with valid data.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Profile updated successfully.' and data is refreshed.

test_cases.test_case: Update contact info with empty required fields
steps: 1. Navigate to the Update Contact Info page.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees error messages indicating that required fields must be filled.

test_cases.test_case: Manage cards - request card successfully
steps: 1. Navigate to the Manage Cards page.
2. Fill in all fields in the card request form with valid data.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Card request submitted successfully.' with a tracking ID.

test_cases.test_case: Manage cards - request card with incomplete address
steps: 1. Navigate to the Manage Cards page.
2. Fill in all fields in the card request form but leave Shipping Address incomplete.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that the Shipping Address must be complete.

test_cases.test_case: Manage cards - update card controls successfully
steps: 1. Navigate to the Manage Cards page.
2. Select an existing card from the dropdown.
3. Set a new Spending Limit within policy.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Card controls updated successfully.'

test_cases.test_case: Manage cards - update card controls with invalid spending limit
steps: 1. Navigate to the Manage Cards page.
2. Select an existing card from the dropdown.
3. Set a Spending Limit above policy.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that the Spending Limit exceeds policy.

test_cases.test_case: Investments - execute trade successfully
preconditions: User is logged in with sufficient buying power.
steps: 2. Fill in all fields in the trade funds form with valid data.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Trade executed successfully.' with an order ID.

test_cases.test_case: Investments - execute trade with insufficient buying power
preconditions: User is logged in with insufficient buying power.
steps: 2. Fill in all fields in the trade funds form with valid data but insufficient quantity.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating insufficient buying power.

test_cases.test_case: Investments - execute trade with maximum quantity
preconditions: User is logged in with sufficient buying power.
steps: 2. Fill in all fields in the trade funds form with maximum valid quantity.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Trade executed successfully.' with an order ID.

test_cases.test_case: Create recurring investment plan successfully
preconditions: User is logged in with sufficient funds.
steps: 2. Fill in all fields in the recurring investment plan form with valid data.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Plan created successfully.'

test_cases.test_case: Create recurring investment plan with insufficient funds
preconditions: User is logged in with insufficient funds.
steps: 2. Fill in all fields in the recurring investment plan form with valid data but insufficient funds.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating insufficient funds.

test_cases.test_case: Create recurring investment plan with past start date
steps: 2. Fill in all fields in the recurring investment plan form with a past Start Date.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that the Start Date must be in the future.

test_cases.test_case: Generate account statement successfully
steps: 1. Navigate to the Account Statements page.
2. Select valid Statement Period and Account.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Statement generated successfully.' with the relevant transactions.

test_cases.test_case: Generate account statement with invalid date range
steps: 1. Navigate to the Account Statements page.
2. Select invalid Statement Period (e.g., end date before start date).
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Unable to generate statement — please try again later.' error message.

test_cases.test_case: Update e-statement preference successfully
steps: 1. Navigate to the Account Statements page.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'e-Statement preference updated.'

test_cases.test_case: Update e-statement preference with invalid email format
steps: 1. Navigate to the Account Statements page.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that the Email Address must be valid.

test_cases.test_case: Change password successfully
steps: 1. Navigate to the Security Settings page.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Password changed successfully.'

test_cases.test_case: Change password with incorrect current password
steps: 1. Navigate to the Security Settings page.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that the current password is incorrect.

test_cases.test_case: Change password with mismatched new passwords
steps: 1. Navigate to the Security Settings page.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that New Password and Confirm New Password must match.

test_cases.test_case: Change password with maximum length new password
steps: 1. Navigate to the Security Settings page.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Password changed successfully.'

test_cases.test_case: Send secure message successfully
steps: 1. Navigate to the Support Center page.
2. Fill in all fields in the secure message form with valid data.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Message sent successfully.' with a ticket ID.

test_cases.test_case: Send secure message with empty subject
steps: 1. Navigate to the Support Center page.
3. Fill in other fields with valid data.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that the Subject is required.

test_cases.test_case: Send secure message with empty message body
steps: 1. Navigate to the Support Center page.
2. Fill in Subject field with valid data.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that the Message Body is required.

test_cases.test_case: Request callback successfully
steps: 1. Navigate to the Support Center page.
2. Fill in all fields in the schedule callback form with valid data.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees 'Callback request submitted.' and receives an email confirmation.

test_cases.test_case: Request callback with past preferred date
steps: 1. Navigate to the Support Center page.
2. Fill in all fields in the schedule callback form with a past Preferred Date.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that the Preferred Date must be at least the next business day.

test_cases.test_case: Request callback with invalid phone number format
steps: 1. Navigate to the Support Center page.
2. Fill in all fields in the schedule callback form with an invalid Phone Number format.
test_cases.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating that the Phone Number must follow the format (123) 456-7890.
